exceptions.reason: packages/ts/testing/interfaces/typescript.mts reads the declarations of the TypeScript client with the JavaScript API of the compiler (createSourceFile, the printer and the node factory), which TypeScript 7.0 does not ship; typescript 6.0.3 is the latest release with that API, the same exception as config/toolchain.json.
exceptions.removalCondition: TypeScript ships its stable JavaScript API (announced for 7.1) and packages/ts/testing/interfaces/typescript.mts reads the declarations through it.

advisoryExceptions.reason: GHSA-xcx6-jx8p-x3h5 (npm advisory 1243111) affects the auth_code flow in @azure/msal-node 6.0.1, pulled by @azure/identity 4.13.3 through @vscode/vsce 4.0.0. The only checked-in invocation is `vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license --out dist/polyspec-dbspec.vsix`; no repository command uses vsce publish/login or its --azure-credential option, so the vulnerable authorization-code entry point is not used by the checked workflows. The latest compatible @azure/identity 4.14.0 still requires @azure/msal-node ^6.0.0 and releases 6.0.0/6.0.1 are the only published 6.x versions, while the advisory is fixed in 7.1.0. Forcing the unsupported major would violate the parent package range.
advisoryExceptions.removalCondition: A release of @azure/identity supports patched @azure/msal-node >=7.1.0, or @vscode/vsce no longer depends on the vulnerable packages; rerun make dependency-review.
